name: Can water damage repainting cover mold?

mainEntity.name: Can water damage repainting cover mold?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, water damage repainting cannot effectively cover or eliminate mold. Painting over mold is a temporary cosmetic fix that does not address the underlying issue. Mold must be properly remediated and removed before any repainting takes place. Painting over mold will not kill it; the mold will continue to grow beneath the paint, potentially spreading and causing further damage to your property and posing health risks. Professional mold remediation involves containment, removal, and cleaning of affected surfaces before drying and repainting.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, painting over mold is not effective and dangerous; mold must be professionally remediated and removed completely before any repainting.
